jersey_number_art.method: Full ten-digit family measured from official club-shop Nike Game jersey product fill contours. Each digit normalized to shared native height/baseline; source photo contour approximations are explicitly retained. Mesh/perforation speckles omitted below 400 source px area; colour and outline keys preserved. No marketing font used.

width_calibration.method: Trailing or centred single-digit primary photo controls replace foreshortened leading-digit widths; DEN6 uses explicit repeated77 template factor. Individual glyph widths are retained, not forced equal. All native heights/baselines/colours unchanged.

home.note: 2026 home (Sunset Orange): orange jersey, navy collar, navy BRONCOS above white numbers with a thin navy outline, navy triangles, white and navy peaks at the cuffs, white pants with an orange hip wedge and navy stripe, orange socks, Midnight Navy helmet

pants.note: the white rects clear the retail 1997 tapered side panel (x 107-166 and 345-404, y to 201) that lies outside the band the tool clears

helmet.note: the 1997-2023 centre stripe becomes shell navy (rules limited to its box); the 2024 orange triangle clusters are drawn on the centre line x 162 (four clusters of three, direction INFERRED). Both retail decals are upright left-facing copies, so the boxes are not named 'upper' (no 180 turn) and the mark is the club horse mirrored.

recolour.note: the lower jersey falls inside the card's fixed helmet box; the jersey navy sits about 0.09 from the helmet navy family, so a tight rule moves only the jersey

venue.notes: Broncos home games at the retail Invesco Field scene: the same building is Empower Field at Mile High in 2026. End zones: painted Sunset Orange with BRONCOS in navy block letters and a thin white outline (2026 week 2 tilt-shift photo; both ends orange with navy letters; the far end's word could not be read, so both read BRONCOS: INFERRED; letterforms from a bold geometric font, INFERRED). s08 has no midfield texture (u4 is scoping a native fix); the centre logo is authored anyway (the club horse, full colour, hand step). The wall strips, seat logo and ad boards already carry the unchanged 1997 horse and are left retail. The scoreboard's INVESCO FIELD becomes EMPOWER FIELD and its 2004 date line reads BRONCOS COUNTRY. Fan banners: 2026 players.
